random.seed(7)

 seen=set()

  if a==1514 or b==1514: continue
  if (a,b) in seen: continue
  seen.add((a,b)); patterns[c].append((a,b))
# discovery fragments pair list duplicates
discovery=[]
for c in range(classes):
 seqs=[]
 for p in patterns[c]:
  seqs += [p,p]
 # 128 rows *16 =2048
 for r in range(128):
  vals=[0]*128; act=[0]*128
  for q in range(16):
   p=seqs[r*16+q]
   pos=q*8
   vals[pos]=p[0]; vals[pos+1]=p[1]
   act[pos]=20; act[pos+1]=20
  discovery.append({'class':c,'values':vals,'activation':act})
# train
train=[]
for i in range(1000):
 c=i%2; a=random.randrange(0,3029); b=random.randrange(0,3029)
 if a==1514:a=1513
 if b==1514:b=1513
 train.append({'class':c,'values':[a,b]})
# validation pattern rows + random
validation=[]
for c in range(classes):
 for p in patterns[c]:
  vals=[p[0],p[1]]+[random.randrange(0,3029) for _ in range(121)]
  vals=[1513 if x==1514 else x for x in vals]
  validation.append({'class':c,'values':vals})
 # fill to4096 per class =>3072 random
 for _ in range(3072):
  vals=[random.randrange(0,3029) for _ in range(123)]
  vals=[1513 if x==1514 else x for x in vals]

     'discovery':discovery,'train':train,'validation':validation}
# ops: 2048 installs + 1000 flows with matching first pattern

for i in range(2048): ops.append(['install','m'])
for i in range(1000):
 p=patterns[i%2][i%1024]

 # features 1614,1414 don't match p; instead match actual pattern impossible via packet length only chooses features from two fixed sets. Use arbitrary packets no match then close backup.
